footer.system: TB-CDSS | Eto Atilẹyin Ipinnu Iṣegun Arun Kọ́kọ́rọ́ Ẹ̀dọ̀fóró
sidebar.note_text: Atilẹyin fun ayẹwo TB ni kutukutu ati ni aabo.
home.title: Eto Ayẹwo ati Iṣiro Ewu Arun Kọ́kọ́rọ́ Ẹ̀dọ̀fóró
home.description: Eto ori ayelujara fun ayẹwo TB alakoko, iṣiro ewu, iṣeduro idanwo yàrá, ati atilẹyin ede pupọ.
home.card1_text: Ṣe iranlọwọ fun ìmú ìfura TB ni kutukutu.
home.card2_text: N pese ipele ewu, iṣeduro, ati imọran idanwo yàrá.
home.card3_text: Ṣe atilẹyin Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, Yorùbá, Hausa ati Igbo.
screen.title: Fọọmu Ayẹwo Alaisan TB
screen.description: Tẹ alaye alaisan ati awọn aami aisan sii lati ṣe iṣiro ewu ati gba iṣeduro.
screen.form.title: Ayẹwo Alaisan
screen.form.text: Pari fọọmu ni isalẹ lati ṣe iṣiro ewu TB ati gba iṣeduro iṣegun.
screen.symptom_text: Yan idahun to ba awọn aami aisan mu.
screen.q2: Ṣe ikọ naa ti ju ọsẹ meji lọ?
screen.q3: Ṣe o maa n rẹ̀wẹ̀sì loru?
screen.q4: Ṣe o ti padanu iwuwo lai mọ idi?
screen.q5: Ṣe o n kọ ẹjẹ jade?
screen.q7: Ṣe o maa n rẹ nigbagbogbo?
dashboard.title: Akopọ Oṣiṣẹ Ilera
dashboard.text: Ṣakoso awọn igbasilẹ ayẹwo ati awọn abajade ewu.
dashboard.high_text: Awọn alaisan ti o nilo ayẹwo pajawiri
dashboard.emergency_text: Awọn alaisan ti o nilo gbigbe lọ lẹsẹkẹsẹ
dashboard.empty_records: Ko si igbasilẹ ayẹwo alaisan sibẹ.
result.title: Iṣiro Ewu TB Alaisan
result.text: Abajade yii jẹ fun atilẹyin ayẹwo alakoko nikan, kii ṣe ayẹwo dokita gangan.
result.lab_test: Awọn Idanwo Yàrá Ti A Ṣeduro
result.next.text: Tẹle iṣeduro loke ki o kan si amoye ilera to yẹ.
recommendation.low: Tẹsiwaju pẹlu awọn ilana ilera to dara ki o maa ṣe atẹle awọn aami aisan.
recommendation.moderate: Ṣabẹwo si ile-iwosan fun idanwo sputum smear microscopy.
recommendation.high: Ayẹwo kiakia nilo. Ṣe idanwo GeneXpert ati X-ray àyà.
recommendation.emergency: Gbigbe pajawiri nilo lẹsẹkẹsẹ fun GeneXpert, X-ray àyà ati idanwo aṣa TB.
test.low: Ko si idanwo yàrá lẹsẹkẹsẹ ti a nilo.
test.moderate: Idanwo ti a ṣeduro: Sputum smear microscopy.
test.high: Awọn idanwo ti a ṣeduro: GeneXpert ati X-ray àyà.
test.emergency: Awọn idanwo pajawiri: GeneXpert, X-ray àyà ati TB culture/drug susceptibility testing.
login.badge: Wiwọle Fun Oṣiṣẹ Ilera Ti A Fọwọsi
login.title: Wiwọle Oṣiṣẹ Ilera
login.text: Wọle pẹlu alaye iwọle rẹ lati wọle si awọn igbasilẹ ati awọn irinṣẹ eto.
login.form_text: Awọn oṣiṣẹ ilera ti a fun ni aṣẹ nikan ni o le wọle.
login.notice_text: Kan si alakoso eto ti o ko ba ni alaye iwọle.
